name: Jahmyr Gibbs
note: Near-unanimous 1.01; CBS calls passing on him at 1 a league-losing mistake.

name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
note: 4for4 and the Footballguys thread list him at 4-6; PFN calls him one of the safest picks in fantasy.

name: Bijan Robinson
note: Field Yates' RB1; five more 20-point PPR games than Gibbs over two years.

name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
note: FantasyPros No. 7 and the accepted fallback; FTN fades him slightly on the coordinator change.

name: Jonathan Taylor
note: ADP 1.07 everywhere; elite floor, conditional ceiling. Nobody puts him at 4 in PPR.

name: Ja'Marr Chase
note: WR1 on five boards; only knock is Burrow's health and a minor knee hyperextension.

name: Puka Nacua
note: The industry default at 1.04, but side work Aug 31 and an open NFL review with no Week 1 deadline.

name: Christian McCaffrey
note: SI lists him among three early-round busts; even PFN wants him at 7-8, and 4for4 only in standard.

name: Chase Brown
note: The most-endorsed round-2 back: CBS 'perfect second-round pick', PFN 'belongs at the 1/2 turn'.

name: Omarion Hampton
note: Underdog No. 15 and named Week 1 starter, but Yahoo's 'RB16 on RB16 usage' and FTN's cold water.

name: Kenneth Walker III
note: PFF names him a pick-4 target; PFN says his price is steamed up after the Super Bowl MVP run.

name: Derrick Henry
note: Age 32, no receiving floor; no back since 2000 has averaged 16 a game at 32 or older.

name: James Cook III
note: Consensus RB5 but he comes off boards at the 1-2 turn, so he rarely reaches 17.

name: Saquon Barkley
note: ETR prefers him to Jefferson and Lamb; FTN calls him the worst pick of round 1.

name: De'Von Achane
note: Yates RB5 and the clear upside play, but Miami cut Tua and Hill and traded Waddle.

name: Ashton Jeanty
note: Ankle sprain Aug 23, DNP Sept 2. Yahoo: everything points to him playing except practice.

name: Chris Olave
note: Karabell tier 2 and one of FTN's best-pick-of-the-round names; we were missing him.

name: A.J. Brown
note: Now a Patriot with Vrabel and Maye; PFN sees top-five upside if the touchdowns bounce back.

name: Drake London
note: Karabell tier 1, but Tua struggled so badly in camp that Penix may start.

name: Nico Collins
note: Karabell tier 1 and the target tree just thinned: Higgins tore an ACL, Dell out four games.

name: Brock Bowers
note: CBS and Yahoo say as early as mid round 2; ten picks ahead of the FFC and Underdog boards.

name: George Pickens
note: The most-cited regression call in this range, but our model has him at bust 21.

name: Breece Hall
note: Reich wants to run, but RotoBaller asks if he is overvalued and the Jets' QB room is shaky.

name: Malik Nabers
note: Would not commit to Week 1; DK Network calls him the biggest unknown in football.

name: Tee Higgins
note: PFN ranks him WR14 against a WR19 ADP; SI picks him over both Wilson and Egbuka.

name: Zay Flowers
note: Heath Cummings' top draft target; RotoWire leans him over Higgins specifically in PPR.

name: Garrett Wilson
note: Karabell WR10 on a 30% target share, but Geno Smith may not change much.

name: Tetairoa McMillan
note: Undisputed Carolina WR1; the whole bet is whether you trust Bryce Young.

name: DeVonta Smith
note: With A.J. Brown gone CBS expects his best season; Yahoo also lists him among WR busts.

name: Colston Loveland
note: TE3 at ADP 48 with the upside to be the TE1; Chicago's schedule is the caution.

name: Ladd McConkey
note: 4for4 calls him a bargain at WR20; McDaniel arrives and Keenan Allen left for the Colts.

name: Rome Odunze
note: Bears WR1 after the DJ Moore trade; the Sept 3 practice exit was cramps.

name: Emeka Egbuka
note: League-winning upside, but three weeks without practice on turf toe and SI cut him to WR26.

name: Quinshon Judkins
note: Fantasy Life's perfect mid-round back; CBS wants the later side of 4-6, PFN says priced too high.

name: Travis Hunter
note: ADP 69 and Jacksonville plans to use him more as a defensive back.

name: Lamar Jackson
note: ADP 56 with a career-worst 26.8 rushing yards a game; FantasyPros ran the case against.

name: Cam Skattebo
note: SI's most overvalued player, a Rotoworld top fade, on PFF's avoid list.

name: Luther Burden III
note: Ben Johnson said he is buying stock; slot receivers have always produced in his offense.

name: Drake Maye
note: 350.9 points last season and he added A.J. Brown and Doubs; the tier's best name.

name: MarShawn Lloyd
note: Bumped 60 spots to top-65 after Jacobs went on the exempt list; over-under about six games.

name: Jalen Hurts
note: Fantasy Life priority target; new coordinator and no A.J. Brown is the sticking point.

name: Jayden Daniels
note: Rushing edge over Burrow, but knee, hamstring and elbow limited him to seven games in 2025.

name: Bucky Irving
note: NBC and PFN say rebound; CBS's Cummings has him on the do-not-draft list.

name: Joe Burrow
note: ADP drifted from the late 50s into the 70s and 80s; missed seven games in two of three years.

name: Chris Godwin Jr.
note: ADP 128. Yahoo: the name is more valuable than the projection.

name: Harold Fannin Jr.
note: ESPN's unquestioned No. 1 in Cleveland, TE4 in two ranking sets, four TE1 weeks in his last five.

name: Caleb Williams
note: QB8 last year and rising; SI says there is little reason to force the first name from this tier.

name: Tucker Kraft
note: Cleared for full contact and will play Week 1, but zero preseason snaps and a slow-ramp warning.

name: Justin Herbert
note: Reworked mechanics under McDaniel; CBS puts him in the rounds 6-7 QB group.

name: Jaylen Warren
note: ADP slipped into the late 80s with his starting role intact; Draft Sharks calls it exceptional value.

name: Jadarian Price
note: Slid toward pick 90 on preseason caution; Charbonnet's knee opens the job.

name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
note: Fair from the middle of round 7 in full PPR, but the advice is explicitly do not chase him.

name: Sam LaPorta
note: Petzing's arrival is the case; ADP 111 and a summer hip scare are the caution.

name: TreVeyon Henderson
note: ADP fell from the mid-40s to the late 80s on the ankle; cleared, but Stevenson grades better.

name: Bhayshul Tuten
note: PFN: his ADP spiked on opportunity, not production.

name: Kyler Murray
note: Going in the 10th round and a QB1 in points per game every year he has played eight games.

name: Blake Corum
note: The most-cited handcuff in football: 39% of carries and 55% inside the five from week 10 on.

name: Dalton Kincaid
note: Led all tight ends in targets and points per route in 2025 with the Bills ready to expand his role.

name: Stefon Diggs
note: NFL.com's tenth-round sleeper; he is 33 and our model has him at boom 20, bust 98.

name: George Kittle
note: Activated from PUP with a legitimate chance at Week 1; our model still has him at bust 99.

name: Isaiah Likely
note: Followed Harbaugh to the Giants and projects as the No. 2 target behind Nabers.

name: Jordan Mason
note: PFF sleeper with weekly must-start upside behind a 31-year-old Aaron Jones.

name: Jaxson Dart
note: FantasyPros lists him among five QB2s with a real path to a top-five finish; ADP is this exact pick.

name: Matthew Stafford
note: ADP 75-76 makes him a round-8 name, and his 7.7% touchdown rate has to regress.

name: Josh Downs
note: ESPN calls him a lower-risk flier; the Keenan Allen signing and a calf injury cut the ceiling.

name: Jonathon Brooks
note: ESPN's bust-to-boom candidate at ADP 125 with Carolina confident in the recovery.

name: Kyle Monangai
note: An elite handcuff on talent, but week-to-week with a knee and may miss Week 1.

name: Tyler Allgeier
note: A Week 1 flex if Jeremiyah Love (50-50) sits, but blocked again once Love is healthy.

name: RJ Harvey
note: Dobbins sits atop the depth chart and Denver drafted Jonah Coleman; he is a passing-down back.

name: Keaton Mitchell
note: Six straight practices missed; Hampton is the clear lead back.

name: Rachaad White
note: Croskey-Merritt has the edge, and White has had a hamstring since Aug 19.

name: Kaelon Black
note: The only healthy back behind McCaffrey and he handled the starters' workload in preseason.

name: Ja'Kobi Lane
note: Baltimore's new No. 2 opposite Flowers with stated red-zone usage, at ADP 172.

name: Caleb Douglas
note: Played 100% of Miami's first-team snaps on the starters' lone preseason drive; Week 1 starter.

name: De'Zhaun Stribling
note: Zooming up boards since Pearsall's season-ending injury, but Deebo Samuel is back.

name: Mike Washington Jr.
note: CBS: one of the best handcuffs in fantasy, an immediate volume RB2 if Jeanty misses time.

name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
note: Just 2.9% of his touches are receptions, which caps him badly in full PPR.
